answer.summary: E2E failed because the OpenAEV API never started: Spring threw an UnsatisfiedDependency error at startup, so /api/me returned HTTP 000 for 300s. The PR only changes the Dockerfile (Renovate bumping eclipse-temurin to 25), so the new base image is the likely cause. The startup error is deterministic and will repeat on re-run. The log is truncated and does not name the missing bean, so this is inferred from the change, not confirmed.
